profile.business_thesis: Operating-business-only scenario: autos, energy and services retain separately observed drivers, then aggregate at the consolidated level. No incremental Robotaxi or robotics payoff is modeled. Unmodeled business option and investment asset values remain unknown.

revenue.rationale: Q3 revenue was $28.046bn vs $28.095bn. Autos were $20.560bn vs $21.205bn, energy $2.881bn vs $3.415bn, and services $4.605bn vs $3.475bn. Nine-month consolidated revenue increased from $69.926bn to $78.669bn. Aggregate scenario paths stress auto volume/pricing and energy/services mix without including new unproved commercialization.

operating_margin.rationale: TTM operating margin is near 3.35%. Endpoints 4/7.5/12% express thin incremental margin, restored operating leverage or sustained higher contribution; 9M CapEx rising to $13.01bn from $6.13bn is a cash and future depreciation constraint. No automated FCF conversion.

conversion.rationale: Current GAAP EPS and parent net income remain unchanged and unnormalized. The SEC cash flow statement identifies an $863m unrealized SpaceX investment gain for nine months; 62/72/78% projected net-to-operating ratios use operating profit and allow for tax and ordinary below-line costs. No extrapolation of unrealized investment gains or explicit capitalization of the investment; no unproved tax adjustment.

shares.rationale: Annual incremental net diluted share paths 2.5/1.5/0.8% are conditional post-baseline dilution stresses, not forecasts of vesting or authorization. The 10-Q identifies the approximately 423.7m share 2025 CEO performance award. Do not re-add grants already included in diluted EPS; subsidiary, performance and regulatory conditions can move outcomes outside these cases.

terminal_pe.rationale: 15/22/30x terminal operating scenarios distinguish low-margin auto/energy economics from a stronger mix and better demonstrated cash conversion. No qualified historical PIT PE distribution supports a statistical estimate; 30x requires lasting growth and 12% operating margin rather than implied gains from unpriced optionality.

risks: Operating earnings start from GAAP; neither realized non-operating cash nor durable normalized taxes can be inferred from the current quarter.
SBC, performance vesting and cash CapEx pressure can coexist with higher revenue and weaker shareholder cash returns.
Unmodeled autonomous driving, robots and investment assets may materially change whole-company value. Conditional returns only describe the specified operating scenario.
